protocol.name: M
protocol.matching: For each prediction, select the highest-IoU same-class ground truth over all candidates. A hit requires IoU strictly greater than the threshold; a second hit on an already-matched object is a false positive.
protocol.T18_note: The eight YOLO states also retain the same-prediction T18 sensitivity values. C2Former T18 entries, where present, are explicitly labelled historical rounded companions.
